newsitem.title: SWEDEN: VBG says acquires Germany's Ringfeder.
newsitem.headline: VBG says acquires Germany's Ringfeder.

text.p: Swedish trailer coupling maker VBG Produkter AB said on Friday it is acquiring its main German competitor, Ringfeder, and its sales company in the U.S. for about 70 million mark.
Ringfeder is currently owned by Duewag AG which is part of the Siemens group.
"Through the acquisition, VBG will become the world's leading manufacturer of trailer couplings for heavy vehicles," it said in a statement.
The acquisition price is dependent on the next six months' order intake and sales but is estimated to be roughly 70 million marks, the company said.
The acquisition will partly be financed through a new share issue, VBG said, adding it saw the deal having a positive impact on its 1997 earnings.

The deal will boost its annual sales to about 640 million crowns from a 1996 turnover of 281 million. Last year Ringfeder's turnover amounted to 355 million crowns. The number of VBG employees will increase to 441 from 211.
VBG expects to take over Ringfeder on April 29 and run it in its current form, while the economic effects from the deal are effective April 1, the company said.
